style.styleTitle: Scottish Everlastings Ltd Artificial Mixed Branch 6ft Christmas Tree
style.toneOfVoice: Create a stunning festive centrepiece with this 6ft artificial mixed branch Christmas tree, designed to bring natural charm and seasonal elegance into your home. Featuring a blend of lifelike branch tips, this tree offers a rich, full appearance that beautifully mimics the texture and depth of a real Christmas tree. The mixed foliage combines classic pine with varied greenery, adding visual interest and a more realistic finish. Its full shape provides the perfect canvas for your favourite decorations, whether you prefer a traditional, cosy look or a more modern, styled theme. Standing at an impressive 6ft, this tree is ideal for living rooms, dining areas or hallways, creating a warm and inviting festive atmosphere. Easy to assemble and designed for lasting use, it offers all the beauty of a real tree without the mess of needles or the need for maintenance. Perfect for bringing Christmas magic to your home year after year, this tree is a timeless addition to your festive décor collection. Stand Dims: H15xD51cm.
